name: Gnoblin
body:
Gnoblins are miserable humanoids that appear to be a cross between a gnome and a goblin—hence the name—although they claim vociferously to be unrelated to either.

Physical

Most gnoblins look like disheveled, dirty gnomes with oversized heads stuffed with even larger teeth. Their skin comes in goblin-colored tones, ranging from grayish green to midnight blue, and their eyes are solid orbs of pink, orange, or red. Gnoblins of both sexes wear loose clothing and dirty armor. Males are usually bald, and sometimes the females as well, but they may have tufts of brightly colored hair around their ears if not on their entire head.

Some gnoblins exhibit genetic variations and mutations, usually just cosmetic. This may include skins of different colors and patterns, different-shaped ears or noses, and features that are more bestial than normal.

Social

Gnoblins are antisocial psychopaths known to sabotage every relationship, and as such they are shunned even by goblins. They dwell underground in cramped, rat-infested warrens or in emote wilderness where no one else can find them—but they still live in constant fear of each other, paranoid that their own kin will stab them in the back.

Gnoblins are naturally gifted at magic, and enjoy using their powers to cause mischief and suffering. Although largely antisocial, they enjoy the company of giant bats, rats, and vermin, and will sometimes ally themselves with evil fey.

Alignment and Religion

Gnoblins are usually Chaotic Evil. Though not especially religious, gnoblins offer prayers to various dark powers for protection, most often to demon lords.

Core Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are physically nimble, and surprisingly strong for your size, but mentally weak. Your ability score adjustments are +4 Dex, –2 Int, –2 Wis, –2 Cha [paragon].
Size As a Small creature, you have a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a +1 size bonus to your Armor Class, a –1 size penalty to your CMB, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks. You must use smaller weapons than Medium creatures. As a Small creature, you occupy a space of 5 feet by 5 feet. Your reach is 5 feet.
Type Traits You are a Humanoid with the gnome and goblinoid subtypes.
Speed Your base speed is 30 feet.
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Gnoblish. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Abyssal, Draconic, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Orc, and Undercommon.
Alternate Traits
Senses Darkvision. You have darkvision 60 feet.
Gnoblin Magic If your Charisma score is at least 11, you can use the following spell-like abilities: 1/day—blurred movement, ghost sound, pass without trace, and ventriloquism. Your caster level for these abilities is equal to your character level, and Charisma is your casting ability.
Rat Speaker Traits You can use speak with animals as a constant spell-like ability, but only to speak with rats and bats, including giant, dire, and similar versions of these animals.
Sneaky You gain a +2 species bonus to Stealth checks.
Swift as Shadows Traits You reduce the penalty for using Stealth while moving at full speed by 5, and you reduce the Stealth check penalty for sniping by 10.
Gnoblin Variant
Xvizlor

Some gnoblins are born with greater intellectual capacity, displaying greater comprehension and leadership potential than their peers. Known as xvizlors, they are more likely to rise to the top and become leaders of gnoblin warrens.

Ability Scores You gain +2 Dex, +2 Int, –2 Wis. This trait alters ability scores.
Alternate Species Traits
Diviner’s Bane You gain a +2 species bonus on saving throws against divination effects. This trait replaces sneaky.
Feral Traits You have a more bestial, rat-like appearance than most gnoblins, including a wide mouth filled with pointed teeth. You gain a bite attack. This is a primary natural attack that deals 1d3 damage. This trait replaces gnoblin magic.
Overbearing Tactics If at least one of your allies threatens an opponent that you also threaten, you gain a +2 species bonus on any attempt you make to bull rush, overrun, or reposition that opponent, and your attempts at these combat maneuvers do not provoke attacks of opportunity. This trait replaces swift as shadows.
Rat Catcher You gain proficiency with nets. This trait replaces rat speaker.
Run Away Traits You do not provoke attacks of opportunity the first time each round that you leave a space threatened by one or more of your opponents. Passing through additional squares threatened by your opponents provokes attacks of opportunity as normal. This trait replaces swift as shadows.
Thievery Traits You gain a +2 species bonus on Sleight of Hand checks. This trait replaces swift as shadows.
Favored Class Bonuses
Alchemist Add one extract known from the alchemist formula list. This extract must be at least one level below the highest-level alchemist extract you can prepare.
Bloodrager Add one spell known from the bloodrager spell list. This spell must be at least one spell level below the highest-level bloodrager spell you can cast.
Fighter Choose the dirty trick or steal combat maneuver. Add +1/3 to your CMB when attempting this maneuver (maximum bonus of +4).
Rogue Add +1/3 on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using sneak attack (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Slayer Add +1/3 on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using sneak attack (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Sorcerer Add one spell known from the sorcerer spell list. This spell must be at least one spell level below the highest-level sorcerer spell you can cast.
Summoner Add one spell known from the summoner spell list. This spell must be at least one spell level below the highest-level summoner spell you can cast.
Witch Add +1 hit point to your familiar. If you ever replaces your familiar, the new familiar gains these bonus hit points.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
